rationale: On the plan's own terms, this is implementation-ready and consistent with the trust model. E1–E6 close the release blockers with fail-closed mechanics and adversarial fixtures: sole deterministic merge credential with agent/publisher/controller separation, producer-bound check eligibility, out-of-tree anchored memory-gate authority with Eye-signed multi-surface transitions, exceptionless auditor, production-profile default flip, and discriminating mutation-registry oracles with baseline-controlled negatives. Governance correctly sequences a docs/registry-only bootstrap under sitting v15 (successor publish → exact-hash authorize → pivot/supersede → Eye confirmation) without touching AM-42 bytes, with AM-43 as exclude-only enrollment and this council as the enrollment-flip re-authorization. Product Phase-0 is frozen with a hard typed item-bound go-live gate and no report-only escape; Phase-1a states an honest source-release install with dual checkout/archive doctor semantics, clean-room proof, draft-first publish, and out-of-tree signer fingerprint; flagship stays Chromium-qualified this round. Atomic weave plus CI authoritative/historical mode-split are machine-enforced. Deferred Phase-1b+/multi-engine/self-contained-npm items and cited Eye rulings are correctly out of conditioning scope. No remaining internal contradiction blocks AS-IS authorization.
